## Open Consent Request
Writes a PENDING row to the Consent Requests sheet tab, DMs the incumbent booker (Approver) to ask consent, and posts an audit line to #jessie-approvals (C0C34UMFXGD). Called by Book/Move at the ROOM_OCCUPIED+outrank point. Row write must succeed (fails loud); the two Slack posts are best-effort (onError continue). Logic mirrors workflows/drafts/consent/open-request.js (offline-tested). NOTE: set the real Consent Requests gid on Write Pending Row before wiring.
